Name: LegSoftIK
Description: Soft IK for Limb v002 legs (v003: same math as the Limb ArmsSoftIk, works with the Foot RFL, names found from the IK handle)

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Soft IK for legs built with Limb v002 and the Foot block: the leg eases to straight instead of popping at full reach.
  v003: same math as the Limb v002 ArmsSoftIk, the IK handle is pulled back along the hip -> foot direction, so the foot roll keeps working.

How To Use:
  build the leg (Limb v002) and the foot (Foot v002) first, then this block.

Fields:
- Mirror: True builds both sides from the left names, False left only, Right_Only right only.
- LeftIKHandle: leg IK handle (the Foot block parents it under its RFL). The joints, stretch distance and stretch condition are found from it.
- LeftSoftIkAttrHolder: node that gets the SoftIk attr (0-10) and has the Upper_Length / Lower_Length attrs (the limb switch locator).
- SoftIkDefault: SoftIk value at build. SoftIk 10 = soft zone of 20% of the leg length, 0 = off.
- Stretch: with Stretch_On the stretch starts where the soft zone starts, the foot stays on the controller.

Tips:
- v002 and older need Limb v001 legs (hard coded names, L_Pelvis_Ctrl, Global_Ctrl / Mover_Ctrl).
